tasks.label: Briefcase: prep — symlink build dirs out of iCloud (auto)
tasks.detail: Helper — runs automatically before steps 1-3, no need to pick it manually. Symlinks build/ and dist/ to ~/.briefcase-out (outside iCloud) so iCloud does not evict / UF_HIDDEN the artifacts and break codesigning. Idempotent.

tasks.label: Briefcase: 1. create macOS app
dependsOn: Briefcase: prep — symlink build dirs out of iCloud (auto)
tasks.detail: STEP 1 (one-time): scaffold the .app bundle and install its dependencies. Run once; re-run only after changing dependencies. PIP_FIND_LINKS points pip at wheelhouse/ for the docopt wheel (docopt is sdist-only; Briefcase installs bundle deps with --only-binary).

tasks.label: Briefcase: 2. build macOS app
dependsOn: Briefcase: prep — symlink build dirs out of iCloud (auto)
tasks.detail: STEP 2: compile pdf-md-anonymizer.app. -u copies fresh source into the bundle before building, so source-only edits are always picked up. Requires step 1 to have run at least once. This is the default build task (Cmd+Shift+B).

tasks.label: Briefcase: 2a. clean rebuild (delete bundle + create + build)
tasks.command: rm -rf "$HOME/.briefcase-out/pdf-md-anonymizer/build" && mkdir -p "$HOME/.briefcase-out/pdf-md-anonymizer/build" && uvx briefcase create macOS && uvx briefcase build macOS
dependsOn: Briefcase: prep — symlink build dirs out of iCloud (auto)
tasks.detail: STEP 2a (use when step 2 does not pick up changes): wipes the build directory, re-scaffolds the bundle from scratch (reinstalls all deps), then builds. Slower than step 2 but guaranteed fresh.

tasks.label: Briefcase: prep — strip numpy .so signatures (auto)
tasks.detail: Helper — runs automatically before step 3, no need to pick it manually. Strips existing signatures from numpy .so files so Briefcase's parallel codesign does not hit a race condition on the .cstemp temp files. Idempotent (already-unsigned files are silently skipped).

tasks.label: Briefcase: 3. package macOS app
tasks.command: uvx briefcase package macOS && DMG=$(ls "$HOME/.briefcase-out/pdf-md-anonymizer/dist/"*.dmg | head -1) && hdiutil convert "$DMG" -format UDRW -o /tmp/briefcase_rw.dmg -ov -quiet && hdiutil attach /tmp/briefcase_rw.dmg -nobrowse -mountpoint /tmp/briefcase_mount -quiet && cp "${workspaceFolder}/First Launch.txt" "/tmp/briefcase_mount/" && hdiutil detach /tmp/briefcase_mount -quiet && rm "$DMG" && hdiutil convert /tmp/briefcase_rw.dmg -format UDZO -o "$DMG" -quiet && rm /tmp/briefcase_rw.dmg && echo "DMG ready: $DMG"
dependsOn: Briefcase: prep — symlink build dirs out of iCloud (auto)
tasks.detail: STEP 3 (optional): produce a distributable .app/.dmg. Requires step 2. The prep tasks keep artifacts outside iCloud and pre-strip numpy signatures so parallel codesigning does not race.

tasks.label: Briefcase: run macOS app
tasks.detail: Launch the built .app directly. We bypass `uvx briefcase run macOS` because it fails on this repo: the `build/` symlink (iCloud workaround, see step 0 prep) means `open -n` resolves to `~/.briefcase-out/...`, but briefcase searches for a process whose cmdline starts with the symlinked path — paths never match, `app_pid is None`, and briefcase exits with code 200 even though the .app is running. Launching the Mach-O binary directly bonds the terminal to the app: Python stderr (tracebacks, our `_log` lines) streams to this terminal, and Ctrl-C kills the app. Run step 2 (build) first.
